issue.title: Review-walk settle reads the answered task's after-line at its pre-write index, which a BLOCKS insertion above shifts
issue.description:
Found while fixing the Ctrl+Shift+B cursor/viewport jump (bob-navigation-hotkeys 2.45.2). Repo: bob-plugins (linked).

`BulletPropertyPickerModal.settleReviewOrigin` (`plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/350-picker-task-card.js`) reads the after-line with `getEditorLine(this.editor, this.reviewLineIndex)` — the line index captured before the write. A same-note write can shift the reviewed task: when a same-note prerequisite above the reviewed task gains a generated `🧱 BLOCKS:` line, the reviewed task moves down one line, so `reviewLineIndex` now points at the BLOCKS line (or, after a prerequisite removal that deletes a BLOCKS line above, at the line above). `continueReviewWalkAfter` then receives the wrong `afterLine` and may misjudge whether the answered row left today's walk (`decisions:answering-advances-the-walk`).

Root cause: the after-line is looked up at a pre-write index instead of the planner's post-write line (`plan.parentLineNext`, or a mapping through the committed line alignment). Fix direction: have the writers hand the settle step the dependent's post-write line (or map `reviewLineIndex` through the same alignment `applyEditorContentTransaction` now computes), and add a review-walk test where a same-note prerequisite above the reviewed task gains a BLOCKS line.

task_type_fields.impact: The walk may misjudge whether the answered row left the walk, so it can advance or stay incorrectly after a same-note Depends-On commit from a review landing.
task_type_fields.repro: Open a note with a same-note prerequisite directly above a task; land the review walk (]s) on that task; Ctrl+Shift+B, pick the prerequisite above (BLOCKS mirror is on by default). The dependent moves down one line, but settleReviewOrigin reads getEditorLine(editor, reviewLineIndex) at the old index, which is now the generated BLOCKS line.

issue.creation_reason: Recorded as a follow-up of the keep-cursor-on-dependency-stage-commits plan: the same stale pre-write line index that mis-aimed the freshness stamp also feeds settleReviewOrigin.
